attempts.text:
Syaphru school can't be reached because its only road is damaged, so those 4 children are deferred. The other 14 people are rescued in four trips. The elderly at Dupcheshwar are reached through Shivapuri market, since the direct road from the shelter is damaged. The adults are split across two trips: the 4 at Benighat need one trip, and the 3 at Gosaikunda need another.

<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market dupcheshwar-market
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 dupcheshwar-market shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market dupcheshwar-market
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 dupcheshwar-market shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-care-home
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home benighat-market
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 benighat-market gosaikunda-care-home
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-care-home
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer syaphru-school child 4
</plan>

COST: 496

(Driving 256 minutes + 240 penalty for the 4 deferred children.)
